comment on table tag_dict is '标签字典：学科/类目/学段/年级/难度/题型';

-- ============================================================
-- 管理端账号与 RBAC
-- ============================================================
create table admin_user (
    id            uuid        primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    username      text        not null unique,
    password_hash text        not null,
    display_name  text        not null default '',
    status        text        not null default 'active',
    last_login_at timestamptz,
    created_at    timestamptz not null default now(),
    constraint admin_user_status_chk check (status in ('active', 'disabled'))
);

create table admin_role (
    id         uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    code       text not null unique,
    name       text not null,
    created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table admin_permission (
    id         uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    code       text not null unique,
    name       text not null,
    created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table admin_role_permission (
    role_id       uuid not null references admin_role (id) on delete cascade,
    permission_id uuid not null references admin_permission (id) on delete cascade,
    primary key (role_id, permission_id)
);

create table admin_user_role (
    user_id uuid not null references admin_user (id) on delete cascade,
    role_id uuid not null references admin_role (id) on delete cascade,
    primary key (user_id, role_id)
);

-- ============================================================
-- 媒体资源
-- ============================================================
create table media_asset (
    id          uuid        primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    kind        text        not null,
    url         text        not null,
    duration_ms integer,
    hash        text        not null default '',
    status      text        not null default 'draft',
    created_at  timestamptz not null default now(),
    constraint media_asset_kind_chk check (kind in ('image', 'audio', 'video')),
    constraint media_asset_status_chk check (status in ('draft', 'approved', 'rejected')),
    constraint media_asset_duration_chk check (duration_ms is null or duration_ms >= 0)
);

-- ============================================================
-- 专题题包
-- ============================================================
create table topic_pack (
    id             uuid        primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    name           text        not null,
    type           text        not null,
    subject_scope  jsonb       not null default '[]'::jsonb,
    stage_scope    jsonb       not null default '[]'::jsonb,
    start_at       timestamptz,
    end_at         timestamptz,
    is_paid        boolean     not null default false,
    status         text        not null default 'draft',
    created_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
    updated_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
    constraint topic_pack_type_chk check (type in ('holiday', 'ip', 'vacation', 'daily')),
    constraint topic_pack_status_chk check (status in ('draft', 'online', 'offline')),
    constraint topic_pack_subject_scope_chk check (jsonb_typeof(subject_scope) = 'array'),
    constraint topic_pack_stage_scope_chk check (jsonb_typeof(stage_scope) = 'array'),
    constraint topic_pack_time_chk check (end_at is null or start_at is null or end_at > start_at)
);

-- ============================================================
-- 题目主表：唯一题库，学科只是标签。
-- ============================================================
create table question (
    id             uuid        primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    subject_code   text        not null,
    category_code  text        not null,
    stage_code     text        not null,
    grade_tag      text,
    difficulty     smallint    not null,
    type_code      text        not null,
    stem           text        not null,
    stem_media     jsonb,
    options        jsonb,
    answer         jsonb       not null,
    answer_alias   jsonb,
    explain        text,
    duration_limit smallint,
    topic_id       uuid        references topic_pack (id) on delete set null,
    status         text        not null default 'draft',
    version        integer     not null default 1,
    schema_ver     integer     not null default 1,
    created_by     uuid        references admin_user (id) on delete set null,
    reviewed_by    uuid        references admin_user (id) on delete set null,
    created_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
    updated_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
    constraint question_stage_chk check (stage_code in ('preschool', 'low', 'mid', 'high')),
    constraint question_category_chk check (category_code in ('core', 'literacy', 'topic', 'fun')),
    constraint question_difficulty_chk check (difficulty between 1 and 5),
    constraint question_status_chk check (status in ('draft', 'review', 'trial', 'online', 'offline')),
    constraint question_type_chk check (type_code in ('choice', 'voice', 'image', 'fill', 'sort', 'match')),
    constraint question_grade_chk check (grade_tag is null or grade_tag ~ '^g[1-9]$'),
    constraint question_options_chk check (options is null or jsonb_typeof(options) = 'array'),
    constraint question_alias_chk check (category_code <> 'fun' or jsonb_array_length(coalesce(answer_alias, '[]'::jsonb)) > 0),
    constraint question_duration_chk check (duration_limit is null or duration_limit between 5 and 120),
    constraint question_version_chk check (version > 0 and schema_ver > 0)
);

comment on table question is '题目主表：学科/类目/学段/难度/题型均为标签，禁止按学科拆表';

create index question_online_pool_idx on question (stage_code, subject_code, difficulty) where status = 'online';
create index question_online_category_idx on question (category_code, stage_code) where status = 'online';
create index question_topic_idx on question (topic_id) where topic_id is not null;
create index question_review_idx on question (status, updated_at desc);

-- ============================================================
-- 题包与题目关联
-- ============================================================
create table topic_question (
    topic_id    uuid    not null references topic_pack (id) on delete cascade,
    question_id uuid    not null references question (id) on delete cascade,
    position    integer not null default 0,
    primary key (topic_id, question_id)
);

create index topic_question_question_idx on topic_question (question_id);

-- ============================================================
-- 家长账号、家庭、孩子、设备绑定
-- ============================================================
create table parent_account (
    id            uuid        primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    phone_cipher  text        not null,
    phone_hash    text        not null unique,
    password_hash text        not null default '',
    status        text        not null default 'active',
    last_login_at timestamptz,
    created_at    timestamptz not null default now(),
    updated_at    timestamptz not null default now(),
    constraint parent_account_status_chk check (status in ('active', 'disabled'))
);

comment on column parent_account.phone_cipher is '手机号密文（应用层 AES-GCM）';
comment on column parent_account.phone_hash is '手机号 HMAC-SHA256，用于唯一索引与查询';

create table family (
    id            uuid        primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    owner_id      uuid        not null references parent_account (id) on delete restrict,
    member_status text        not null default 'free',
    created_at    timestamptz not null default now(),
    updated_at    timestamptz not null default now(),
    constraint family_member_status_chk check (member_status in ('free', 'member', 'expired'))
);

create index family_owner_idx on family (owner_id);

create table family_member (
    family_id             uuid        not null references family (id) on delete cascade,
    account_id            uuid        not null references parent_account (id) on delete cascade,
    role                  text        not null default 'member',
    second_factor_verified boolean     not null default false,
    joined_at             timestamptz not null default now(),
    primary key (family_id, account_id),
    constraint family_member_role_chk check (role in ('owner', 'member'))
);

create index family_member_account_idx on family_member (account_id);

create table child_profile (
    id          uuid        primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    family_id   uuid        not null references family (id) on delete cascade,
    nickname    text        not null,
    birth_year  smallint,
    birth_month smallint,
    stage_code  text        not null,
    grade_tag   text,
    avatar_url  text,
    created_at  timestamptz not null default now(),
    updated_at  timestamptz not null default now(),
    constraint child_profile_stage_chk check (stage_code in ('preschool', 'low', 'mid', 'high')),
    constraint child_profile_grade_chk check (grade_tag is null or grade_tag ~ '^g[1-9]$'),
    constraint child_profile_birth_chk check (
        (birth_year is null and birth_month is null)
        or (birth_year between 2000 and 2100 and birth_month between 1 and 12)
    )
);

create index child_profile_family_idx on child_profile (family_id);

create table device_bind (
    id               uuid        primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    device_id        text        not null,
    child_id         uuid        not null references child_profile (id) on delete cascade,
    platform         text        not null,
    status           text        not null default 'active',
    token_hash       text        not null default '',
    token_expires_at timestamptz,
    bound_at         timestamptz not null default now(),
    unbound_at       timestamptz,
    constraint device_bind_platform_chk check (platform in ('tv', 'phone', 'pad', 'miniapp')),
    constraint device_bind_status_chk check (status in ('active', 'unbound')),
    constraint device_bind_unbound_chk check (
        (status = 'active' and unbound_at is null)
        or (status = 'unbound' and unbound_at is not null)
    )
);

create unique index device_bind_active_device_idx on device_bind (device_id) where status = 'active';
create index device_bind_child_idx on device_bind (child_id) where status = 'active';

-- ============================================================
-- 规则配置
-- ============================================================
create table watch_rule (
    id                    uuid          primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    child_id              uuid          not null unique references child_profile (id) on delete cascade,
    unlock_minutes        integer       not null default 20,
    pass_threshold        numeric(6, 2) not null default 3,
    subject_weight        jsonb         not null default '{}'::jsonb,
    fun_ratio_cap         integer       not null default 2,
    fun_enabled           boolean       not null default true,
    time_window           jsonb         not null default '{"allow":[{"start":"07:00","end":"21:00"}]}'::jsonb,
    daily_limit           integer       not null default 60,
    offline_fallback_min  integer       not null default 10,
    scope_mode            text          not null default 'media',
    allowed_apps          jsonb         not null default '[]'::jsonb,
    weight_preset         text          not null default 'balanced',
    timezone              text          not null default 'Asia/Shanghai',
    version               integer       not null default 1,
    updated_by            uuid          references parent_account (id) on delete set null,
    updated_at            timestamptz   not null default now(),
    constraint watch_rule_unlock_chk check (unlock_minutes between 1 and 240),
    constraint watch_rule_threshold_chk check (pass_threshold > 0),
    constraint watch_rule_weight_chk check (jsonb_typeof(subject_weight) = 'object'),
    constraint watch_rule_fun_cap_chk check (fun_ratio_cap between 0 and 10),
    constraint watch_rule_daily_chk check (daily_limit between 1 and 720),
    constraint watch_rule_offline_chk check (offline_fallback_min between 0 and 120),
    constraint watch_rule_scope_chk check (scope_mode in ('media', 'custom', 'all_apps')),
    constraint watch_rule_apps_chk check (jsonb_typeof(allowed_apps) = 'array'),
    constraint watch_rule_preset_chk check (weight_preset in ('balanced', 'math', 'literacy', 'custom')),
    constraint watch_rule_version_chk check (version > 0)
);

-- ============================================================
-- 答题会话
-- ============================================================
create table quiz_session (
    id             uuid          primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    child_id       uuid          not null references child_profile (id) on delete cascade,
    device_id      text          not null,
    rule_version   integer       not null,
    state          text          not null default 'active',
    question_count integer       not null default 0,
    pass_threshold numeric(6, 2) not null,
    score          numeric(6, 2) not null default 0,
    paused_app     text,
    was_playing    boolean       not null default false,
    paused_at      timestamptz,
    resumed_at     timestamptz,
    started_at     timestamptz   not null default now(),
    expires_at     timestamptz   not null,
    finished_at    timestamptz,
    constraint quiz_session_state_chk check (state in ('active', 'passed', 'failed', 'expired', 'cancelled')),
    constraint quiz_session_count_chk check (question_count between 0 and 30),
    constraint quiz_session_score_chk check (score >= 0)
);

create index quiz_session_child_idx on quiz_session (child_id, started_at desc);
create index quiz_session_active_idx on quiz_session (device_id, state) where state = 'active';

create table quiz_session_item (
    id              uuid        primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    session_id      uuid        not null references quiz_session (id) on delete cascade,
    question_id     uuid        not null references question (id) on delete restrict,
    question_version integer    not null,
    answer_snapshot jsonb       not null,
    position        integer     not null,
    answer_token_jti text       not null unique,
    issued_at       timestamptz not null default now(),
    answered_at     timestamptz,
    answer_given    jsonb,
    is_correct      boolean,
    duration_ms     integer,
    constraint quiz_session_item_position_chk check (position >= 0),
    constraint quiz_session_item_duration_chk check (duration_ms is null or duration_ms >= 0),
    unique (session_id, position),
    unique (session_id, question_id)
);

create index quiz_session_item_session_idx on quiz_session_item (session_id, position);

-- ============================================================
-- 答题记录（校准与报告数据源）
-- ============================================================
create table answer_log (
    id           bigserial   primary key,
    child_id     uuid        not null references child_profile (id) on delete cascade,
    question_id  uuid        not null references question (id) on delete restrict,
    session_id   uuid        references quiz_session (id) on delete set null,
    device_id    text        not null,
    answer_given jsonb,
    is_correct   boolean     not null,
    duration_ms  integer,
    answered_at  timestamptz not null default now()
);

-- 首期普通表；数据量达到阈值后按 answered_at 月分区（见设计 6.4）
create index answer_log_child_idx on answer_log (child_id, answered_at desc);
create index answer_log_question_idx on answer_log (question_id, answered_at desc);

-- ============================================================
-- 观看授权（服务端签发，客户端执行）
-- ============================================================
create table watch_grant (
    id               uuid          primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    child_id         uuid          not null references child_profile (id) on delete cascade,
    device_id        text          not null,
    session_id       uuid          not null unique references quiz_session (id) on delete restrict,
    minutes          integer       not null,
    valid_from       timestamptz   not null default now(),
    valid_until      timestamptz   not null,
    jti              text          not null unique,
    consumed_seconds integer       not null default 0,
    status           text          not null default 'active',
    created_at       timestamptz   not null default now(),
    constraint watch_grant_minutes_chk check (minutes between 1 and 240),
    constraint watch_grant_consumed_chk check (consumed_seconds >= 0),
    constraint watch_grant_status_chk check (status in ('active', 'exhausted', 'revoked', 'expired')),
    constraint watch_grant_time_chk check (valid_until > valid_from)
);

create index watch_grant_child_idx on watch_grant (child_id, valid_from desc);
create index watch_grant_active_idx on watch_grant (device_id, status) where status = 'active';

-- ============================================================
-- 应用使用记录与离线租约
-- ============================================================

    constraint watch_log_time_chk check (end_at >= start_at),
    constraint watch_log_seconds_chk check (watched_seconds >= 0 and paused_seconds >= 0)
);

create index watch_log_child_idx on watch_log (child_id, start_at desc);
create index watch_log_grant_idx on watch_log (grant_id);

create table offline_lease (
    id               uuid        primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
    device_id        text        not null,

create index offline_lease_device_idx on offline_lease (device_id, expires_at desc);

-- ============================================================
create table device_capability (
    device_id        text        primary key,
    guard_mode       text        not null default 'standard',
    permissions      jsonb       not null default '{}'::jsonb,

    last_reported_at timestamptz not null default now(),
    constraint device_capability_mode_chk check (guard_mode in ('standard', 'device_owner')),

);

create index tamper_event_device_idx on tamper_event (device_id, reported_at desc);
create index tamper_event_child_idx on tamper_event (child_id, reported_at desc);

-- ============================================================

create table growth_report (
    id            uuid        primary key default gen_random_uuid(),

create index audit_log_created_idx on audit_log (created_at desc);

input.content:
# OpenQuizGo

面向家庭的儿童电视使用管理服务：孩子在电视上答题，按**加权分**解锁第三方视频 App 的使用时长；家长在手机端配置规则、查看报告。服务端是唯一裁决者，电视端只负责执行与上报。

> 项目规约见 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)：所有对话留档、所有开发先设计后实施。
> 设计基线：[`docs/design/001-项目总体设计方案.md`](docs/design/001-项目总体设计方案.md)
> 实施计划：[`docs/plans/001-项目总体实施计划.md`](docs/plans/001-项目总体实施计划.md)

## 当前进度

- ✅ T1 工程骨架
- 🚧 T2 数据模型与迁移
- ⏳ T0 设备管控 PoC（需电视实机）
- ⏳ T3–T12

## 技术栈

- 服务端：Go 1.25（模块化单体）、PostgreSQL、Redis
- 迁移：goose（SQL 内嵌，单二进制）
- 电视端：Android TV（Kotlin + Compose for TV）
- 家长端：Flutter

## 目录结构

```
cmd/api           HTTP 服务入口
cmd/migrate       数据库迁移入口
internal/config   环境变量配置
internal/httpapi  路由、中间件、统一响应
internal/platform 数据库 / Redis / 日志适配
migrations        SQL 迁移（goose）
docs              设计、计划、对话归档
```

## 本地启动

前置：Go 1.25+、PostgreSQL 14+、Redis 6+。

```bash
cp .env.example .env
# 按本机情况修改 DATABASE_URL / REDIS_URL

createdb openquizgo
make migrate-up
make run
```

验证：

```bash
curl localhost:8080/healthz
curl localhost:8080/readyz
curl localhost:8080/v1/meta
```

## 常用命令

```bash
make help           # 查看全部命令
make test           # 单元测试
make vet            # 静态检查
make build          # 编译到 bin/
make migrate-up     # 执行迁移
make migrate-down   # 回滚一个迁移
make dev            # 迁移并启动
```

## 容器启动

```bash
docker compose up --build
```

## 配置

| 变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `APP_ENV` | `dev` | `dev` 输出文本日志，其他输出 JSON |
| `APP_VERSION` | `dev` | 版本号，透传到 `/v1/meta` |
| `HTTP_ADDR` | `:8080` | 监听地址 |
| `DATABASE_URL` | 无（必填） | PostgreSQL DSN |
| `REDIS_URL` | `redis://localhost:6379/0` | Redis DSN |
| `DB_MAX_CONNS` | `10` | 连接池上限 |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `info` | debug / info / warn / error |
| `SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT` | `10s` | 优雅退出超时 |

## 守护端能力边界（重要）

观看内容为第三方 App，播放器不可控：

- 拦截依赖「使用情况访问 + 悬浮窗 + 无障碍」（标准模式）或 Device Owner（增强模式）。
- 答题暂停/恢复按 MediaSession → 音频焦点 → 媒体按键组合尝试，属**尽力而为**。
- HDMI、投屏、手机热点不在管控范围。

以上能力须经第 0 期 PoC 在目标机型上验证，详见设计 4.6–4.8。

# 数据模型说明

> 对应设计：[001-项目总体设计方案](design/001-项目总体设计方案.md) 第 6 节
> 实现：`migrations/00001_init.sql`、`migrations/00002_seed_tags.sql`
> 最后更新：2026-11-02

## 1. 设计原则

1. **单题库**：只有 `question` 一张题目主表，学科/类目/学段/题型都是标签。
2. **标签字典化**：`tag_dict` 是取值的唯一来源，新增学科/题型只插数据。
3. **答案不出服务端**：`answer` / `answer_alias` 仅服务端可见；会话中另存答案快照用于稳定判分。
4. **服务端裁决**：规则、判分、授权、额度全部落库留痕。
5. **JSON 带版本**：`schema_ver` 描述结构版本，`version` 描述内容修订。

## 2. 实体关系

```mermaid
erDiagram
    PARENT_ACCOUNT ||--o{ FAMILY_MEMBER : joins
    FAMILY ||--o{ FAMILY_MEMBER : contains
    FAMILY ||--o{ CHILD_PROFILE : has
    CHILD_PROFILE ||--|| WATCH_RULE : has
    CHILD_PROFILE ||--o{ DEVICE_BIND : binds
    CHILD_PROFILE ||--o{ QUIZ_SESSION : takes
    QUIZ_SESSION ||--o{ QUIZ_SESSION_ITEM : contains
    QUIZ_SESSION ||--o| WATCH_GRANT : grants
    WATCH_GRANT ||--o{ WATCH_LOG : records
    QUESTION ||--o{ QUIZ_SESSION_ITEM : used_in
    QUESTION }o--o{ TOPIC_PACK : grouped_in
    CHILD_PROFILE ||--o{ GROWTH_REPORT : has
    CHILD_PROFILE ||--o{ ANSWER_LOG : answers
    CHILD_PROFILE ||--o{ OFFLINE_LEASE : offline
    DEVICE_CAPABILITY ||--o{ TAMPER_EVENT : reports
```

## 3. 表分组

| 分组 | 表 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 字典 | `tag_dict` | 学科/类目/学段/年级/难度/题型 |
| 题库 | `question`、`topic_pack`、`topic_question`、`media_asset` | 单表题库 + 题包关联 |
| 身份 | `parent_account`、`family`、`family_member`、`child_profile` | 家长、家庭组、孩子档案 |
| 设备 | `device_bind`、`device_capability`、`tamper_event` | 绑定、能力/权限、异常上报 |
| 规则 | `watch_rule` | 每孩子一条，带版本 |
| 答题 | `quiz_session`、`quiz_session_item`、`answer_log` | 会话、题目快照、答题记录 |
| 授权 | `watch_grant`、`watch_log`、`offline_lease` | 使用授权、应用使用、离线租约 |
| 报告 | `growth_report` | 周/月聚合 |
| 治理 | `admin_user`、`admin_role`、`admin_permission`、`admin_user_role`、`admin_role_permission`、`audit_log` | RBAC 与审计 |

## 4. 关键约束

| 约束 | 实现 |
| --- | --- |
| 学段只能是四档 | `question.stage_code` / `child_profile.stage_code` CHECK |
| 趣味题必须有近义答案 | `category_code='fun'` 时 `answer_alias` 数组非空 |
| 一台设备同时只绑一个孩子 | `device_bind (device_id) WHERE status='active'` 部分唯一索引 |
| 一个孩子一条规则 | `watch_rule.child_id` UNIQUE |
| 一次会话只能签发一次授权 | `watch_grant.session_id` UNIQUE |
| 一次会话内题目不重复 | `quiz_session_item (session_id, question_id)` UNIQUE |
| 答题令牌一次性 | `quiz_session_item.answer_token_jti` UNIQUE |
| 暂停时长不计额度 | `watch_log.paused_seconds` 单列，结算时排除 |
| 手机号可查不可逆 | `phone_cipher`（AES-GCM）+ `phone_hash`（HMAC）唯一索引 |

## 5. 迁移

```bash
make migrate-up       # 应用全部迁移
make migrate-down     # 回滚一个迁移
make migrate-status   # 查看状态
```

- 迁移内嵌在 `cmd/migrate` 二进制中，部署时无需额外文件。
- `00002_seed_tags.sql` 可重复执行（`ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE`），回滚不删除标签。
- 生产迁移仅向前；`down` 用于开发与预发演练。

## 6. 已知取舍

| 项 | 当前实现 | 后续 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 日志表分区 | `answer_log` / `watch_log` 首期普通表 + 索引 | 数据量达标后按 `answered_at` / `start_at` 月分区迁移 |
| sqlc | 暂未引入，T3 起用 pgx 手写 SQL | 查询稳定后评估 sqlc 生成 |
| 手机号加密 | 字段与索引已就绪，加解密在应用层 | T3 实现 KMS/本地密钥与迁移工具 |
| 软删除 | 未引入 `deleted_at` | 以状态字段为主；确需软删时统一加列 |

# 设备管控 PoC（T0）

验证「第三方视频 App 的暂停/恢复与遮罩拦截」在目标电视上的可行性。纯 Java、零第三方依赖，APK 约 0.8 MB。

## 构建

方式一（Android Studio）：打开 `android/` 目录，直接运行 `app`。

方式二（命令行，需 Gradle 9.x + JDK 17+）：

```bash
cd android
gradle assembleDebug
# 产物：app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
```

> `local.properties` 中的 `sdk.dir` 需指向本机 Android SDK，该文件不入库。

## 安装

```bash
adb connect <电视IP>:5555     # 电视需开启开发者模式与网络调试
adb install -r app-debug.apk
```

## 使用步骤

1. 打开 **OpenQuizGo PoC**。
2. 依次点击并授权：
   - 无障碍服务（识别前台应用）
   - 悬浮窗（全屏遮罩）
   - 通知使用权（读取 MediaSession，用于最精准的暂停/恢复）
   - 使用情况访问（验证前台应用统计）
3. 打开目标视频 App 播放视频，按 Home 回到 PoC（或从最近任务切回）。
4. 依次测试：
   - `A. MediaSession 暂停 / 恢复`
   - `B. 请求音频焦点 / 释放`
   - `C. 媒体键暂停 / 播放`
   - `5. 显示全屏遮罩`（验证是否盖住播放画面、遥控器焦点是否被拦截）
5. 观察界面状态区：
   - 前台应用（无障碍上报）
   - MediaSession 包名与播放状态
   - 每次操作的耗时（毫秒）

日志同时输出到 logcat：

```bash
adb logcat -s OQG_POC
```

## 结果记录表

每个 App 填一行。「暂停/恢复」记录成功与否、耗时与异常现象。

| App | 版本 | MediaSession 可读 | A 暂停 | A 恢复 | B 暂停 | B 恢复 | C 暂停 | C 恢复 | 遮罩覆盖 | 识别延迟 | 备注 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 爱奇艺 | | | | | | | | | | | |
| 腾讯视频 | | | | | | | | | | | |
| 优酷 | | | | | | | | | | | |
| 芒果 TV | | | | | | | | | | | |
| 云视听小电视 | | | | | | | | | | | |
| Netflix | | | | | | | | | | | |
| YouTube | | | | | | | | | | | |

## 判定口径（暂定）

- 暂停成功率 ≥ 90%、恢复成功率 ≥ 85%，且从操作到画面暂停 ≤ 500ms。
- 遮罩需能覆盖全屏播放画面，遥控器方向键/确认键不得穿透到下层 App。
- 关闭无障碍/悬浮窗后，PoC 能检测到（状态区变 ✗）。

## 已知边界

- 仅验证标准模式（无障碍 + 悬浮窗 + 使用统计），不含 Device Owner。
- 部分 App 不暴露 MediaSession 或不响应媒体键，需在表中如实记录。
- 系统设置、HDMI 输入、投屏不在本 PoC 覆盖范围。

	UpdatedAt     time.Time       `json:"updated_at"`

| 授权签发 | 会话结算 `passed` 后自动签发 `watch_grant`；同一会话幂等 |

| 暂停不计量 | 客户端 `paused=true` 或存在进行中的答题会话 → 只累计 `paused_seconds` |

package main

import (
	"context"
	"log/slog"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/roma007/OpenQuizGo/internal/config"
	"github.com/roma007/OpenQuizGo/internal/platform/database"
	"github.com/roma007/OpenQuizGo/internal/platform/logx"
	"github.com/roma007/OpenQuizGo/internal/report"
)

func main() {
	cfg, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		slog.Error("load config", "error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	logger := logx.New(cfg.LogLevel, cfg.Env)
	slog.SetDefault(logger)

	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()

	initCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := database.Open(initCtx, cfg.DatabaseURL, cfg.DBMaxConns)
	if err != nil {
		logger.Error("connect database", "error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	defer pool.Close()

	svc := report.New(pool, logger)
	run := func() {
		start := time.Now()
		count, err := svc.GenerateAll(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			logger.Error("generate reports", "error", err)
			return
		}
		logger.Info("reports generated", "count", count, "duration_ms", time.Since(start).Milliseconds())
	}

	run()
	ticker := time.NewTicker(cfg.ReportInterval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			logger.Info("worker shutting down")
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
			run()
		}
	}
}
EOF

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: OpenQuizGo API
  version: 0.1.0
  description: |
    答题解锁电视使用时长的服务端 API。第一期覆盖服务端全部能力：
    身份/家庭/设备、题库治理、组卷、答题判分、规则引擎、授权计量、
    离线租约、成长报告与可观测性端点。

    鉴权方式均为 `Authorization: Bearer <token>`，但令牌类型不同：
    - 家长令牌：`/auth/login` 获取，访问 `/family/*`
    - 设备令牌：`/device/token` 获取，访问 `/quiz/*`、`/watch/*`、`/child/context`
    - 管理员令牌：`/admin/auth/login` 获取，访问 `/admin/*`
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8080
    description: 本地开发
tags:
  - name: auth
  - name: family
  - name: device
  - name: quiz
  - name: watch
  - name: report
  - name: admin
  - name: system
paths:
  /healthz:
    get:
      tags: [system]
      summary: 存活探针
      security: []
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
  /readyz:
    get:
      tags: [system]
      summary: 就绪探针（数据库/Redis）
      security: []
      responses:
        "200": { description: Ready }
        "503": { description: Not ready }
  /metrics:
    get:
      tags: [system]
      summary: Prometheus 指标
      security: []
      responses:
        "200": { description: Prometheus text format }
  /v1/meta:
    get:
      tags: [system]
      summary: 服务元信息
      security: []
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  service: { type: string }
                  version: { type: string }
                  env: { type: string }

  /v1/auth/sms/code:
    post:
      tags: [auth]
      summary: 发送登录验证码（mock 模式固定 123456）
      security: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [phone]
              properties:
                phone: { type: string, example: "13800138000" }
      responses:
        "200": { description: 已发送 }
        "429": { $ref: "#/components/responses/RateLimited" }
  /v1/auth/login:
    post:
      tags: [auth]
      summary: 手机号 + 验证码登录（首登自动创建家庭）
      security: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [phone, code]
              properties:
                phone: { type: string }
                code: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: 登录成功
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/LoginResult" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
  /v1/auth/refresh:
    post:
      tags: [auth]
      summary: 轮换刷新令牌
      security: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                refresh_token: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: 新令牌
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/LoginResult" }
  /v1/auth/logout:
    post:
      tags: [auth]
      summary: 吊销刷新令牌
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                refresh_token: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }

  /v1/family/me:
    get:
      tags: [family]
      summary: 当前家长账号
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Account" }
  /v1/family/children:
    get:
      tags: [family]
      summary: 孩子列表
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Child" }
    post:
      tags: [family]
      summary: 新增孩子（自动创建默认规则）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ChildInput" }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Child" }
  /v1/family/children/{childID}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/ChildID"
    get:
      tags: [family]
      summary: 孩子详情
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Child" }
    put:
      tags: [family]
      summary: 更新孩子档案
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ChildInput" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Child" }
  /v1/family/pin:
    post:
      tags: [family]
      summary: 设置/修改家长 PIN
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                current_pin: { type: string }
                new_pin: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
  /v1/family/pin/verify:
    post:
      tags: [family]
      summary: 校验家长 PIN
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                pin: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }
  /v1/family/members:
    get:
      tags: [family]
      summary: 家庭成员（手机号脱敏）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
  /v1/family/members/invite:
    post:
      tags: [family]
      summary: 生成家庭邀请码
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
  /v1/family/members/join:
    post:
      tags: [family]
      summary: 使用邀请码加入家庭
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                code: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
  /v1/family/children/{childID}/rule:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/ChildID"
    get:
      tags: [family]
      summary: 读取孩子规则
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  rule: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Rule" }
                  version: { type: integer }
    put:
      tags: [family]
      summary: 更新规则（需 PIN）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [pin, rule]
              properties:
                pin: { type: string }
                rule: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Rule" }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }
        "422": { $ref: "#/components/responses/ValidationError" }
  /v1/family/children/{childID}/rule/preview:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/ChildID"
    post:
      tags: [family]
      summary: 规则 dry-run（题量/配额/最高加权分）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                rule: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Rule" }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }

  /v1/family/devices:
    get:
      tags: [device]
      summary: 已绑定设备
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
  /v1/family/devices/activate:
    post:
      tags: [device]
      summary: 家长凭激活码绑定孩子
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [code, child_id]
              properties:
                code: { type: string }
                child_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
  /v1/family/devices/{deviceID}:
    delete:
      tags: [device]
      summary: 解绑设备（令牌立即失效）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - name: deviceID
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
  /v1/family/children/{childID}/reports:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/ChildID"
    get:
      tags: [report]
      summary: 周/月成长报告
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - name: period
          in: query
          schema: { type: string, enum: [week, month], default: week }
        - name: limit
          in: query
          schema: { type: integer, default: 8 }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }

  /v1/device/activate/code:
    post:
      tags: [device]
      summary: 电视端申请激活码
      security: []
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [device_id, platform]
              properties:
                device_id: { type: string }
                platform: { type: string, enum: [tv, phone, pad, miniapp] }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
  /v1/device/token:
    post:
      tags: [device]
      summary: 电视端兑换设备令牌
      security: []
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [code, device_id]
              properties:
                code: { type: string }
                device_id: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200": { description: 已绑定 }
        "202": { description: 等待家长确认 }
  /v1/device/me:
    get:
      tags: [device]
      summary: 设备信息
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
  /v1/device/capability:
    put:
      tags: [device]
      summary: 上报守护模式与权限状态
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
  /v1/device/tamper:
    post:
      tags: [device]
      summary: 上报权限关闭/卸载等异常
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }

  /v1/child/context:
    get:
      tags: [device]
      summary: 电视端可看状态
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
  /v1/quiz/sessions:
    post:
      tags: [quiz]
      summary: 创建答题会话
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: 会话与题目（不含答案）
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateSessionResponse" }
        "409": { description: 已有进行中的会话或题库不足 }
        "429": { $ref: "#/components/responses/RateLimited" }
  /v1/quiz/sessions/{sessionID}:
    get:
      tags: [quiz]
      summary: 会话状态（断线恢复）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - name: sessionID
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
  /v1/quiz/sessions/{sessionID}/answers:
    post:
      tags: [quiz]
      summary: 提交答案（一次性令牌）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - name: sessionID
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [token, answer]
              properties:
                token: { type: string }
                answer: {}
      responses:
        "200":
          description: 判分结果
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/AnswerResult" }
        "409": { description: 令牌已使用/会话结束 }
        "410": { description: 会话过期 }
  /v1/quiz/sessions/{sessionID}/finish:
    post:
      tags: [quiz]
      summary: 结算会话（可能签发授权）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - name: sessionID
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: 结算结果
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SessionSummary" }

  /v1/watch/grants/active:
    get:
      tags: [watch]
      summary: 当前有效授权
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
        "404": { description: 无有效授权 }
  /v1/watch/grants/{grantID}/heartbeat:
    post:
      tags: [watch]
      summary: 心跳计量
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - name: grantID
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                foreground_app: { type: string }
                paused: { type: boolean }
                position_seconds: { type: integer }
      responses:
        "200": { description: 计量结果 }
  /v1/offline/lease:
    get:
      tags: [watch]
      summary: 预签发离线租约（Ed25519）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
        "403": { description: 时段/额度不允许 }
  /v1/watch/logs:
    post:
      tags: [watch]
      summary: 离线观看记录对账
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [lease_id, entries]
              properties:
                lease_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                entries:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      start_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
                      end_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
                      watched_seconds: { type: integer }
                      paused_seconds: { type: integer }
                      target_app: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200": { description: 对账结果 }
        "409": { description: 已对账 }

  /v1/admin/auth/login:
    post:
      tags: [admin]
      summary: 管理员登录
      security: []
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [username, password]
              properties:
                username: { type: string }
                password: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
        "401": { description: 凭据错误 }
  /v1/admin/me:
    get:
      tags: [admin]
      summary: 当前管理员与权限
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
  /v1/admin/questions:
    get:
      tags: [admin]
      summary: 题库四维检索
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - { name: subject, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: category, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: stage, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: difficulty, in: query, schema: { type: integer } }
        - { name: type, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: status, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: q, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: limit, in: query, schema: { type: integer, default: 20 } }
        - { name: offset, in: query, schema: { type: integer, default: 0 } }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
    post:
      tags: [admin]
      summary: 创建题目（draft）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/QuestionInput" }
      responses:
        "201": { description: Created }
        "422": { $ref: "#/components/responses/ValidationError" }
  /v1/admin/questions/import:
    post:
      tags: [admin]
      summary: 批量导入（JSON 或 CSV）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                questions:
                  type: array
                  items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/QuestionInput" }
          text/csv:
            schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
        "422": { description: 任一校验失败则整批未导入 }
  /v1/admin/questions/{id}:
    parameters:
      - name: id
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
    get:
      tags: [admin]
      summary: 题目详情
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
    put:
      tags: [admin]
      summary: 编辑题目（仅 draft/offline）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/QuestionInput" }
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }
        "409": { description: 当前状态不可编辑 }
    delete:
      tags: [admin]
      summary: 删除草稿
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200": { description: OK }

# 部署与运维手册

> 适用版本：0.1.0（第一期服务端）
> 对应设计：[001-项目总体设计方案](design/001-项目总体设计方案.md)

## 1. 组件

| 组件 | 说明 | 必需 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api` | HTTP 服务（家长端、电视端、管理端） | 是 |
| `worker` | 报告聚合定时任务 | 是（可与 api 合并部署） |
| PostgreSQL | 唯一事实来源，建议 16 | 是 |
| Redis | 验证码、限流、设备激活码 | 是 |
| Prometheus | 指标抓取与告警 | 推荐 |
| 反向代理 | TLS 终止、限流、访问控制 | 生产必需 |

## 2. 环境变量

| 变量 | 必填 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `APP_ENV` | 否 | `dev` | `dev` 输出文本日志；其他输出 JSON |
| `APP_VERSION` | 否 | `dev` | 透传到 `/v1/meta` |
| `HTTP_ADDR` | 否 | `:8080` | 监听地址 |
| `DATABASE_URL` | **是** | — | PostgreSQL DSN |
| `REDIS_URL` | 否 | `redis://localhost:6379/0` | Redis DSN |
| `DB_MAX_CONNS` | 否 | `10` | 连接池上限 |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | 否 | `info` | debug/info/warn/error |
| `SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT` | 否 | `10s` | 优雅退出 |
| `JWT_SECRET` | 生产必填 | dev 默认 | 家长/管理端/授权令牌签名，≥32 字符 |
| `ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL` | 否 | `15m` | 家长访问令牌 |
| `REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL` | 否 | `720h` | 刷新令牌 |
| `DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY` | 生产必填 | dev 默认 | 手机号 AES-256-GCM 密钥（base64 32 字节） |
| `PHONE_HASH_KEY` | 生产必填 | dev 默认 | 手机号 HMAC 密钥 |
| `OFFLINE_LEASE_KEY` | 生产必填 | dev 默认 | 离线租约 Ed25519 种子（base64 32 字节） |
| `SMS_MODE` | 否 | `mock` | 生产禁止 `mock`，需接入真实短信通道后设为 `disabled` 或扩展实现 |
| `SMS_MOCK_CODE` | 否 | `123456` | 仅 dev |
| `REPORT_INTERVAL` | 否 | `1h` | worker 聚合间隔 |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` | 否 | 空 | OTLP/HTTP 追踪端点，留空关闭 |

> 生产启动会校验非 dev 环境的密钥与 `SMS_MODE`，缺失或仍为 mock 将拒绝启动。

## 3. 本地运行

```bash
cp .env.example .env
# 修改 DATABASE_URL / REDIS_URL
createdb openquizgo
make migrate-up
make run
```

初始化管理员：

```bash
go run ./cmd/admin create -username admin -password '********' -role super_admin -name 管理员
```

报告 worker：

```bash
make build
./bin/worker
```

## 4. Docker Compose

```bash
docker compose up --build
```

包含：PostgreSQL、Redis、API（启动前自动迁移）、worker、Prometheus（:9090）。

- API：http://localhost:8080
- Prometheus：http://localhost:9090
- 指标：http://localhost:8080/metrics

## 5. 迁移

```bash
make migrate-up       # 应用全部迁移
make migrate-status   # 查看版本
make migrate-down     # 回滚一个（仅开发/预发）
```

- 迁移内嵌在 `migrate` 二进制，生产无需额外文件。
- 发布顺序：备份 → 迁移 → 启动新版本 → 验证 `/readyz`。
- 回滚：镜像回退 + 按需执行 down；数据迁移默认只向前。

## 6. 反向代理（Nginx 示例）

```nginx
server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name api.example.com;

    ssl_certificate     /etc/ssl/api.crt;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/api.key;

    location /metrics {
        allow 10.0.0.0/8;
        deny all;
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8080;
    }

    location / {
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_read_timeout 30s;
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8080;
    }
}
```

- 只暴露 API 与必要端口；PostgreSQL/Redis 不对外。
- `/metrics` 仅允许监控网段。
- 管理端建议独立域名/VPN。

## 7. 监控与告警

- 抓取配置：[`deploy/prometheus/prometheus.yml`](../deploy/prometheus/prometheus.yml)
- 告警规则：[`deploy/prometheus/alerts.yml`](../deploy/prometheus/alerts.yml)
- 关键指标：
  - `openquizgo_http_request_duration_seconds` p95
  - `openquizgo_http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}`
  - `openquizgo_http_in_flight_requests`
  - `openquizgo_quiz_answers_total{result}`
  - `openquizgo_watch_grants_issued_total`
- 日志为 JSON（非 dev），通过 `request_id`/`traceparent` 关联。

## 8. 备份与恢复

```bash
# 每日全量
pg_dump --format=custom --file=/backup/openquizgo-$(date +%F).dump "$DATABASE_URL"

# 恢复
pg_restore --clean --if-exists --dbname="$DATABASE_URL" /backup/openquizgo-YYYY-MM-DD.dump
```

- 建议开启 WAL 归档，RPO ≤15 分钟。
- 对象存储（题干图/音）单独做跨区复制。
- 每季度演练一次恢复。

## 9. 扩容与高可用

- API 无状态，可水平扩容；会话/限流状态在 Redis，授权判断在 PostgreSQL。
- 授权签发使用孩子级 advisory lock，多实例安全。
- worker 可多实例运行（upsert 幂等），建议单实例或加分布式锁以省资源。
- PostgreSQL 主从 + 连接池；Redis 主从/哨兵。
- 容量基线：1 万家庭 / 5 万设备 / 峰值 1000 QPS（设计假设）。

## 10. 发布与回滚

1. 预发执行迁移与全量集成测试。
2. 灰度 5% 设备，观察 5xx、p95、授权拒绝率。
3. 全量发布。
4. 异常回滚镜像；数据库不做破坏性 down，必要时用前向修复迁移。

## 11. 安全

上线前逐项检查 [`docs/security-checklist.md`](security-checklist.md)，重点：

- 替换全部 dev 默认密钥。
- 关闭 `SMS_MODE=mock`。
- `/metrics` 与管理端网络隔离。
- 数据库与 Redis 不暴露公网。
- 开启审计日志与备份加密。

| 场景 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 后台拉起全屏 `QuizActivity`（无障碍服务触发） | ✅ 播放器停止并释放 MediaPlayer |

  MediaPlayer state:started   ← 自动恢复
```

- **电视端核心机制**：检测到目标视频 App 在前台且需要答题时，直接拉起全屏答题/阻挡 Activity；答题结束 `finish()`，播放器自动恢复。

4. **触发时机**：PoC 目前靠 ADB 指令触发，正式版要接「观看时长阈值/答题间隔/额度用尽」。

content.text:
Important requirement refinement: after quiz, video should resume from the position before the quiz, not restart from beginning. On the Coocaa player, our test showed `MediaPlayer state:started` after returning, but maybe it restarted from the beginning (user observed "重头播放"). The user says it restarts from the beginning.

We need to verify and solve: pause vs stop. Our full-screen Activity caused the player to stop/release, and on return the app restarted playback from 0. We need to preserve playback position.

Approaches:
1. Before launching quiz, **pause** the video via the player's own pause control (so it keeps position in memory), then launch full-screen Activity. On return, resume. But pausing requires a control path (MediaSession/media key/accessibility node) — all failed on Coocaa. However, we discovered DPAD_CENTER pauses (shell only). Could we send DPAD_CENTER from an AccessibilityService? `performGlobalAction` doesn't support it, but perhaps an AccessibilityService can **inject a key event** via `Instrumentation`? No.
2. Use the AccessibilityService to click the player's pause button node — root was null earlier. Maybe with `canRetrieveWindowContent` properly loaded (after reboot) it works. If we can click pause, position is preserved because the player stays alive. Then launch our Activity; when the player loses focus while paused, it should keep position. On return, it may stay paused; we'd need to click play or send DPAD_CENTER (same node click) to resume.
   - Root was null, maybe due to service config not reloading (capabilities=0). A reboot could fix; also `canRetrieveWindowContent=true` should set capability. We could reboot the TV to reload, but disruptive. Or the player window is secure/not accessible.
3. Record the current playback position and seek after return:
   - Getting position: MediaSession unavailable; `dumpsys media_player`? Not accessible to app. Accessibility node might expose a seek bar/progress text (e.g., "00:12:34/00:45:00") if we can read nodes (root null).
   - On return, relaunch app and seek to position via player UI (DPAD navigation/seek bar) — fragile.
4. Use `MediaSessionManager` with notification listener (unavailable on this TV).
5. Use Android's `MediaController`? same.
6. Use `AudioManager`/`KeyEvent` injection from an app with `INJECT_EVENTS` — signature permission, unavailable.
7. Use `adb shell input keyevent` only in PoC, not production.
8. **Don't start an Activity that takes the player out of foreground; instead pause via player's pause button**: overlay blocked, but accessibility click might work if root accessible. Need to solve root access.
9. Use PiP? Android TV doesn't support PiP generally.
10. Use a **transparent Activity** on top while keeping the video playing? If our Activity is translucent (not full opaque), the video may keep playing behind; we could show quiz overlay via Activity (not overlay window) with translucent background. But if the video keeps playing, we need to pause it; and pausing is the issue. However, a translucent Activity might let the video continue (audio/video) behind the quiz, violating "暂停". Could mute? Also not pause.

# 002-Android TV 守护端设计

| 项目 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 编号 | 002 |
| 版本 | v1 |
| 状态 | review |
| 作者 | AI |
| 创建日期 | 2026-11-03 |
| 最后更新 | 2026-11-03 |
| 对应计划 | [002-Android TV 守护端实施计划](../plans/002-Android TV 守护端实施计划.md) |
| 上游设计 | [001-项目总体设计方案](001-项目总体设计方案.md) |
| 实机依据 | [`android/README.md`](../../android/README.md) 创维 3T223_P31 实测 |

## 1. 背景与目标

### 1.1 背景

第一期服务端已交付（v0.1.0）。T0 在创维 3T223_P31（Android 9）上的实测结论：

- 悬浮窗被系统白名单拦截，无法覆盖视频；
- 播放器不暴露 MediaSession，忽略音频焦点与媒体键；
- 播放器画面不在无障碍节点树，无法点击暂停；
- 第三方视频 App 侧载被拦截，只能使用商店/预装应用；
- **全屏 Activity 接管可用**：拉起后播放器停止，退出后进度保留、续播，但会重播一次片头广告；
- HOME 逃逸可由无障碍看门狗重新拉起（实测约 0.5s）。

### 1.2 目标

交付可安装、可运营的 Android TV 守护端，实现：

1. 设备激活与家庭绑定；
2. 前台应用识别与观看计时；
3. 到点/额度用尽时全屏接管，完成答题后恢复播放；
4. 与服务端授权、心跳、离线租约、报告体系联动；
5. 家长可配置规则、查看状态，孩子无法轻易绕过。

### 1.3 非目标

- 不做视频内容播放器（观看第三方 App）；
- 不做家长端 App（003 设计）；
- 不做题库后台 UI（第三期）；
- 不承诺管控 HDMI、投屏、其他设备。

## 2. 关键决策

| 决策 | 结论 | 依据 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 暂停/接管方式 | **全屏 Activity 优先**；MediaSession 暂停仅作支持机型增强 | 创维实测 |
| 前台识别 | AccessibilityService 事件 + UsageStats 兜底 | 创维可用 |
| 防逃逸 | 无障碍看门狗：非允许应用前台时重新拉起阻挡界面 | 实测 0.5s |
| 广告代价 | 创维接管后恢复会重播片头广告，**接受**；后续靠厂商/白名单消除 | 产品决策 |
| 第三方 App | 只用商店/预装应用；不做侧载引导 | 创维拦截 |
| 权限最小化 | 使用情况访问 + 无障碍为主；悬浮窗/通知使用权可选 | 合规 |
| 技术栈 | Kotlin + Jetpack Compose for TV + Coroutines/Flow | 001 设计 |
| 最低系统 | Android TV 9（API 28） | 创维实测 |

## 3. 总体架构

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                TV 守护端 App                 │
│                                             │
│  UI 层        Activation / Home / Quiz      │
│               Blocker / PermissionGuide     │
│                                             │
│  领域层       GuardEngine（状态机/触发）      │
│               QuizFlow / WatchFlow          │
│               PolicyEvaluator（本地缓存）     │
│                                             │
│  平台层       ForegroundDetector             │
│               PlaybackController            │
│               DeviceSecurity（Keystore）     │
│               OfflineStore（DataStore/Room） │
│               ApiClient / HeartbeatWorker   │
│                                             │
│  系统能力     AccessibilityService           │
│               UsageStatsManager              │
│               ForegroundService              │
│               BootReceiver                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 3.1 模块职责

| 模块 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `GuardEngine` | 守护状态机、触发答题/阻挡、看门狗、与播放控制协同 |
| `ForegroundDetector` | 前台包名、媒体播放状态、使用时长 |
| `PlaybackController` | 优先 MediaSession 暂停/恢复；不可用时 Activity 接管 |
| `QuizFlow` | 创建会话、拉题、提交、结算、展示解析 |
| `WatchFlow` | 授权查询、心跳、暂停不计量、离线租约与补报 |
| `PolicyEvaluator` | 使用服务端规则快照做本地预判（最终以服务端为准） |
| `OfflineStore` | 设备令牌、规则快照、离线租约、待上报队列 |
| `DeviceSecurity` | Keystore 令牌、设备指纹、时钟校验、完整性检测 |
| `Diagnostics` | 日志、能力上报、篡改事件、崩溃上报 |

## 4. 状态机

```
UNBOUND ──激活──> IDLE
IDLE ──检测到视频前台──> WATCHING
WATCHING ──额度耗尽/到答题点──> QUIZ_REQUIRED
QUIZ_REQUIRED ──拉起答题──> QUIZZING
QUIZZING ──通过──> GRANTED
QUIZZING ──失败/超时──> BLOCKED
GRANTED ──继续观看/心跳──> WATCHING
GRANTED ──授权到期──> QUIZ_REQUIRED
BLOCKED ──家长解锁/重新答题──> QUIZZING
任意 ──解绑/停用──> UNBOUND
```

关键规则：

- 状态持久化，进程重启/电视待机后恢复；
- 答题期间强制心跳 `paused=true`，服务端不计量；
- 阻挡状态下检测到非允许应用前台，看门狗重新拉起；
- 家长端解绑后立即清理令牌与本地状态。

## 5. 前台识别与观看计时

### 5.1 识别

- AccessibilityService 监听 `TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED`，记录前台包名；
- 每 30s 采样 `UsageStatsManager` 校正；
- 播放状态优先用 `MediaSessionManager`（若可用）；不可用时以「前台应用 + 音频播放中」判断；
- 使用 `scope_mode`：
  - `media`：检测到媒体播放才计时/管控；
  - `custom`：仅清单内应用；
  - `all_apps`：除系统白名单外全部管控。

### 5.2 计时

- 本地按 30s 心跳上报，服务端按间隔计费；
- 答题/阻挡期间暂停计时；
- 断网时进入离线模式，使用租约并本地累计，恢复后补报；
- 时钟异常（与服务端偏差 >5 分钟）上报 `clock_skew` 并限制解锁。

## 6. 接管与暂停策略

按优先级尝试：

| 优先级 | 手段 | 适用 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | MediaSession `pause()/play()` | 播放器暴露 MediaSession | 保留进度，无广告 |
| 2 | 音频焦点 | 播放器响应焦点 | 部分机型 |
| 3 | 媒体键 | 有媒体会话 | 兼容性兜底 |
| 4 | **全屏 Activity 接管** | 创维等受限机型 | 停止播放器，进度保留；可能重播片头广告 |
| 5 | 悬浮窗遮罩 | 未被白名单拦截的机型 | Android 10+ 需额外验证 |

- 生产默认顺序：检测能力后动态选择；创维走 4。
- 接管时记录 `was_playing`、前台包名、进入时间；
- 退出后：若播放器自动续播则直接恢复；若停在首页/广告，展示「继续观看」提示，不自动跳转；
- 广告重播：已知限制，文案提示「恢复播放时可能出现片头广告」。

## 7. 答题流程

```
ForegroundDetector 发现视频播放
  -> GuardEngine 拉取 /child/context
  -> 需要答题：启动 QuizActivity（全屏）
  -> POST /quiz/sessions
  -> 展示题目（遥控器/语音）
  -> POST /answers（一次性 token）
  -> POST /finish
  -> 通过：展示授权时长 -> 退出 -> 恢复播放
  -> 失败/超时：BlockerActivity + 重试/回桌面
```

- 题目与选项大字、焦点清晰；低龄支持图片/语音；
- 单题限时与服务端一致；
- 断网时不允许答题解锁，只展示离线说明。

## 8. 授权、心跳与离线

- 启动/唤醒：`GET /watch/grants/active`；
- 心跳：30s，携带 `foreground_app`、`paused`、`position_seconds`；
- 授权到期/吊销：立即拉起阻挡界面；
- 离线：预取 `/offline/lease`，本地验签 Ed25519；播放时长本地累计，恢复后 `/watch/logs` 对账；
- 离线期间不产生新的答题解锁；
- 所有时间以服务端返回的 `server_time` 校正。

## 9. 权限与引导

| 权限 | 必需 | 用途 | 失败处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 无障碍 | 是 | 前台识别、看门狗 | 引导开启，未开启进入受限模式 |
| 使用情况访问 | 是 | 计时校正 | 引导开启 |
| 悬浮窗 | 否 | 部分机型遮罩 | 创维不需要 |
| 通知使用权 | 否 | MediaSession | 无则走 Activity 接管 |
| 前台服务/自启 | 是 | 守护常驻 | 引导电池优化白名单 |
| 安装未知应用 | 否 | 仅内测 | 商店安装 |

首次启动流程：激活码 → 家长绑定 → 权限逐项引导 → 自检 → 进入守护。

## 10. 防绕过

| 场景 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 按 HOME | 看门狗 1s 内重新拉起阻挡 |
| 切换其他 App | 拦截模式重新拉起；允许应用放行 |
| 重启电视 | BootReceiver 启动守护，恢复状态 |
| 关闭无障碍 | 检测并上报 `permission_revoked`，家长端告警 |
| 卸载 | Device Owner 模式禁止；标准模式检测 |
| 改系统时间 | 服务端时间校正，偏差过大限制 |
| 断网 | 离线租约限时，恢复对账 |
| HDMI/投屏 | 明确不支持，协议声明 |

## 11. 非功能

- 启动 ≤3s；守护内存 ≤150MB；心跳耗电可接受；
- 崩溃自动重启守护；关键路径本地日志；
- 隐私：只采集包名/时长/授权状态，不采集画面与内容；
- 合规：家长同意、儿童数据最小化、可注销。

## 12. 测试矩阵

| 维度 | 覆盖 |
| --- | --- |
| 机型 | 创维 3T223_P31（已测）、小米/当贝/TCL/索尼（待测） |
| 系统 | Android 9、10、11、12+ |
| 场景 | 正片/广告/暂停/切集/退出/重启/断网/权限关闭/HOME 逃逸 |
| App | 创维影视、爱奇艺、腾讯、云视听（商店安装） |
| 指标 | 接管延迟、恢复成功率、进度保留、广告重播、看门狗延迟 |

验收口径（暂定）：

- 接管到画面消失 ≤1s；
- 退出后进度保留率 100%（创维实测通过）；
- 看门狗重新拉起 ≤2s；
- 广告重播作为已知机型限制记录，不计失败。

## 13. 风险与未决问题

| 风险 | 影响 | 对策 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Android 10+ 后台 Activity 启动受限 | 接管失败 | 逐机型验证；必要时 Device Owner/悬浮窗 |
| 恢复时重播广告 | 体验 | 接受；厂商白名单/预装消除 |
| 第三方 App 侧载被拦截 | 只能商店安装 | 引导商店安装；厂商合作 |
| 播放器不自动续播 | 需手动继续 | 文案提示 + 恢复按钮 |
| 无障碍被关闭 | 管控失效 | 检测+告警+引导 |
| 语音答题 ASR 成本 | 低龄体验 | 二期先点选，语音后续 |

未决：

- 是否申请 Device Owner 作为增强模式？
- 家长端解锁（临时密码/远程放行）如何设计？
- 广告是否可在恢复时通过播放器历史跳过？
- 多用户/儿童模式与系统账号的关系？

## 14. 变更记录

| 日期 | 变更 | 原因 |

## 4. 验证方式

### 4.1 单元/集成

- 状态机：触发、答题、通过、阻挡、重启恢复；
- 前台识别：窗口事件与 UsageStats 对拍；
- 心跳/离线：断网、时钟偏移、重复上报；
- API 合约：与 v0.1.0 服务端 mock/真实联调。

### 4.2 真机（创维 3T223_P31）

1. 安装 → 激活 → 权限全开；
2. 打开创维影视正片，播放 30s；

5. 心跳 30s 扣减；额度耗尽 → 阻挡；
6. 按 HOME → 看门狗 ≤2s 重新拉起；
7. 断网 5 分钟 → 离线租约 → 恢复对账；
8. 解绑 → 立即停止管控。

We could design: after quiz, show "按确认键继续观看" and let the user press OK; but the ad already occurred on resume before that? If the player auto-resumes, ad starts; user could press OK to pause/resume, but the ad still played.

Could we **prevent auto-resume** so no ad until user confirm? The player auto-resumes when returning; we could keep the quiz Activity open until the user presses a button, then finish; on finish, player resumes with ad. No way to avoid.

## App 目前的真实流程

1. 守护端检测到需要答题；
2. 直接拉起全屏 `QuizActivity`（播放器被顶掉、停止）；
3. 用户答题，答对后关闭界面；

- 暂停视频；
- 保留播放进度；
- 恢复时不出现广告。

content.text:
The user asks: can the app execute adb (shell permission)? This is essentially asking whether the app can run `adb shell` commands / obtain shell privileges.

Answer: No, not normally. Android apps run as their own UID; `adb shell` runs as `shell` (UID 2000) with special permissions (INJECT_EVENTS, etc.). An app cannot elevate to shell. Options:
1. `Runtime.exec("adb ...")` — adb binary not available/doesn't work; even `input` command fails (we tested run-as input, exit 137).
2. Connect to local adbd on port 5555 — requires ADB authentication private key; app can't read `/data/misc/adb/adb_keys` and even with key, ADB protocol from localhost might work? Actually adbd listens on 5555; ADB authentication requires the host's private key that the device authorized. If the app embeds the private key, it could connect (if adbd allows localhost connections and the key is authorized). But:
   - The private key is the developer's host key; embedding it in the app is a severe security risk.
   - The TV's adb_keys file contains the public key; if we embed the matching private key in the app, the app could authenticate. But deploying that key to all devices requires adb authorizing it, and it's a backdoor.
   - Also adbd over network may not allow localhost? It does listen on 0.0.0.0:5555; connecting from the app to 127.0.0.1:5555 should work if authenticated.
   - This is not production-viable and violates security; also user must enable ADB (not acceptable for consumers).
3. Device Owner + `DevicePolicyManager` — doesn't grant shell/INJECT_EVENTS.
4. Root/system signature — can inject input; not available.
5. `adb` over Wi-Fi from a **companion device** (parent phone) could send commands to TV if ADB enabled; not consumer-viable.

So the answer is: technically only via embedding ADB keys / enabling ADB, which is insecure and not shippable; or system privileges. We should not recommend.

But maybe the user is asking for the PoC testing only: can the app execute adb to test? Even for PoC, embedding the host private key and connecting to localhost adbd is possible but hacky. We could demonstrate? Not advisable.

We should explain:
- `adb shell` is not a permission you can request; it's a separate UID (shell) with signature privileges.
- App cannot "become shell"; `su` absent.
- We tested `run-as ... input keyevent` (app UID) → killed.
- Even if we bundle adb binary/key, it's a security backdoor, requires ADB enabled, and consumer TVs won't allow; not acceptable.
- Therefore app-level key injection is closed; OEM/Device Owner remains.

Also mention Device Owner doesn't grant INJECT_EVENTS; it grants app control (suspend, kiosk) but not key injection. However, Device Owner could **suspend the video app** or use lock task; not pause.

Could Device Owner use `setPackagesSuspended` to pause? Suspending an app kills it (not preserve position). Not helpful.

Could OEM system app with `INJECT_EVENTS` do it; yes.

Answer concise with a table of ways and verdict:
| 方式 | 可行性 |
| Runtime.exec("input") | 失败（app UID 无 INJECT_EVENTS） |
| 连接本机 adbd + 内置私钥 | 技术可行但=后门，需开 ADB，消费级不可用 |
| Device Owner | 不能注入按键；只能挂起/锁定 |
| 系统签名/预装 | 可行 |
| root | 可行但无 |

Recommend: don't pursue; continue T2 with ad accepted, or OEM.

Also mention if they want, we can test the adbd+key route **only on this dev TV** to prove the mechanism, but it won't be shippable. Should we offer? `adb shell` 是独立的 `shell` 用户（UID 2000），带 `INJECT_EVENTS` 等系统权限。普通 App：

| 方式 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `Runtime.exec("input keyevent 23")` | 以 App UID 运行，被系统拒绝/终止（我们实测 `run-as ... input` 退出码 137） |
| 申请权限 | `INJECT_EVENTS` 是 signature 权限，无法通过 `pm grant` 获取 |
| 连接本机 adbd:5555 | 需要设备已授权的 ADB 私钥；把私钥内置到 App 等于开后门，且要求用户开 ADB，消费级不可行 |
| Device Owner | 不能注入按键，只能挂起/锁定应用；挂起会杀进程，更不会保留进度 |
| 系统签名 / 厂商预装 / root | 可以，但都不是普通 App 能做到的 |

package com.openquizgo.guard.platform

import android.app.AppOpsManager
import android.content.Context
import android.provider.Settings
import android.os.Process

object Permissions {

    fun accessibilityEnabled(context: Context): Boolean {
        val enabled = Settings.Secure.getString(
            context.contentResolver,
            Settings.Secure.ENABLED_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICES,
        )
        return enabled != null &&
            enabled.contains(context.packageName) &&
            enabled.contains("GuardAccessibilityService")
    }

    fun usageAccessEnabled(context: Context): Boolean {
        val appOps = context.getSystemService(Context.APP_OPS_SERVICE) as? AppOpsManager ?: return false
        val mode = appOps.checkOpNoThrow(
            AppOpsManager.OPSTR_GET_USAGE_STATS,
            Process.myUid(),
            context.packageName,
        )
        return mode == AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED
    }

    fun accessibilitySettingsIntent() = android.content.Intent(Settings.ACTION_ACCESSIBILITY_SETTINGS)

    fun usageSettingsIntent() = android.content.Intent(Settings.ACTION_USAGE_ACCESS_SETTINGS)
}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build OpenQuizGo: a children's TV product where answering quiz questions unlocks screen time for third-party video apps.
- Phase 1 server is delivered (v0.1.0); now building Phase 2 Android TV guard client under `tv/`.

## Requirements
- All conversations archived; all development must follow a written design + plan (project iron rules).
- Content source is third-party apps (not own player); control via TV guard app, no overlay dependency if possible.
- Quiz end must resume video from pre-quiz position with no pre-roll ad — user explicitly rejected restart-from-beginning and repeated ads.
- User accepted earlier ad trade-off, but later found a no-ad flow and expects it.
- Third-party video apps can only be installed from the TV store (sideload blocked).

## Decisions
- Server stack: Go 1.25 modular monolith, PostgreSQL, Redis; deployed/pushed to GitHub + Gitee.
- TV control strategy (design 002 v2): physical **confirm key pauses player → accessibility key filter detects key → 500ms → translucent QuizActivity → user answers → confirm key resumes**; no ad, same MediaPlayer, progress preserved.
- Full-screen opaque Activity is fallback only (stops player, may replay ad).
- App can NOT inject DPAD_CENTER (`INJECT_EVENTS` signature permission; node click/gesture/run-as input all failed); only listens to physical keys.
- Package: applicationId `com.openquizgo.quiz`; namespace `com.openquizgo.guard` (`guard`/`tv` package names blocked by Hisense/Skyworth installer).
- Accessibility service must be enabled after reboot; app updates unregister it, requiring reboot/re-enable on this TV.

## Work State
### Completed
- Phase 1 server (T1–T12) + docs/OpenAPI/acceptance, tag `v0.1.0`.
- T0 PoC on Skyworth 3T223_P31: full flow verified (`WATCHING→QUIZ_REQUIRED→OK→quiz→GRANTED→OK→resume`, player ID unchanged, no ad, original progress).
- P2-T1 project skeleton, P2-T2 activation/binding/token persistence, P2-T3 foreground detection/UsageStats/token Keystore encryption, P2-T4 guard state machine + foreground service + boot receiver, P2-T5 confirm-key + translucent quiz flow.
- Latest commit `0528814`, pushed to GitHub `main` and Gitee `master`; working tree expected clean after last commit.

### Active
- Just finished P2-T5; next planned task is P2-T6 (server-backed quiz session: create session, fetch questions, submit answers, finish, grant).

### Blocked
- Physical TV interactions (play video, press OK) require the user; automated ADB key injection is not seen by accessibility key filter.
- Media-active live timing was only partially verified; `mediaActive=true` logged when video played.

## Next Move
1. Start P2-T6: replace demo QuizActivity question with `POST /v1/quiz/sessions`, answers, `/finish`; map server result to `GuardEngine`.
2. Wire device token auth header for quiz/watch APIs (currently only `/device/me` uses it).
3. Then P2-T7 grant/heartbeat/offline lease integration; P2-T8 blocker/watchdog; P2-T9 permissions/diagnostics.
4. After any TV APK update: reboot TV, re-run `settings put secure enabled_accessibility_services com.openquizgo.quiz/com.openquizgo.guard.platform.GuardAccessibilityService`, set `accessibility_enabled 1`, `appops set com.openquizgo.quiz GET_USAGE_STATS allow`.
5. Use `adb reverse tcp:18080 tcp:18080` + `-PapiBaseUrl=http://127.0.0.1:18080/` for server connectivity.

## Relevant Files
- `tv/app/src/main/java/com/openquizgo/guard/platform/GuardAccessibilityService.kt`: key filter, arm/launch quiz, foreground events.
- `tv/app/src/main/java/com/openquizgo/guard/ui/QuizActivity.kt`: translucent quiz UI; currently hard-coded demo question.
- `tv/app/src/main/java/com/openquizgo/guard/domain/GuardEngine.kt`: state machine and demo 60s threshold.
- `tv/app/src/main/java/com/openquizgo/guard/platform/GuardService.kt`: foreground service, prompt retry, Toast main-thread fix.
- `tv/app/src/main/java/com/openquizgo/guard/ui/GuardViewModel.kt`: activation, binding, diagnostics state.
- `tv/app/src/main/java/com/openquizgo/guard/ui/MainActivity.kt`: activation/bound screens, permission status.
- `tv/app/src/main/java/com/openquizgo/guard/data/remote/GuardApi.kt`: API models/endpoints; expand for quiz/watch.
- `tv/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: permissions, services, QuizActivity, BootReceiver.
- `tv/app/src/main/res/xml/guard_accessibility.xml`: `canRequestFilterKeyEvents="true"`, flags `flagDefault`.
- `tv/app/src/debug/.../DebugReceiver.kt`: `DEBUG_FORCE_QUIZ` explicit broadcast for testing.
- `docs/design/002-Android TV 守护端设计.md`: v2 pause strategy/flow.
- `docs/plans/002-Android TV 守护端实施计划.md`: task statuses/logs; next T6.
- `docs/acceptance/phase1.md`: Phase 1 acceptance and T0 results.
- `android/README.md`: T0 device findings and validated flow.
- `api/openapi.yaml`: server contracts for T6 integration.

## Important Context
- TV: Skyworth `3T223_P31`, Android 9/SDK 28, armv7, IP `192.168.1.207:5555`.
- Verified logs: `confirm key, armed=true`, `quiz activity launched`, `QUIZ_REQUIRED -> QUIZZING`, `QUIZZING -> GRANTED`, player `state:paused` then `state:started` with same ID, no ad.
- User must press physical OK twice (start quiz, resume playback); app only listens.
- Coocaa blocks: overlays over video (`inAddViewBlackList`), MediaSession, audio focus/media key pause, third-party APK sideload, and sometimes marks app `stopped=true`.
- Accessibility XML with `accessibilityFlags="flagDefault|flagRequestKeyEvents"` broke registration; use separate `android:canRequestFilterKeyEvents="true"`.
- `Toast` must run on main thread (fixed via Handler in GuardService).
- Debug trigger: `adb shell am broadcast -n com.openquizgo.quiz/com.openquizgo.guard.debug.DebugReceiver -a com.openquizgo.guard.DEBUG_FORCE_QUIZ` (implicit broadcast is blocked).
- Server test instance runs on port 18080 via `HTTP_ADDR=:18080 ./bin/api`; TV reaches it only through `adb reverse`.
- Activation test child remains “T2孩子”; device token is stored encrypted in DataStore.

package quiz

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"time"

	"github.com/roma007/OpenQuizGo/internal/watch"
)

const sessionTTL = 10 * time.Minute

type ruleSnapshot struct {
	Version int  `json:"version"`
	Rule    Rule `json:"rule"`
}

type itemSnapshot struct {
	Subject       string          `json:"subject"`
	Type          string          `json:"type"`
	Answer        json.RawMessage `json:"answer"`
	Alias         json.RawMessage `json:"alias,omitempty"`
	Explain       string          `json:"explain,omitempty"`
	Stem          string          `json:"stem"`
	StemMedia     json.RawMessage `json:"stem_media,omitempty"`
	Options       json.RawMessage `json:"options,omitempty"`
	DurationLimit *int            `json:"duration_limit,omitempty"`
}

// SessionQuestion 是下发给客户端的题目（不含答案与解析）。
type SessionQuestion struct {
	ItemID        string          `json:"item_id"`
	QuestionID    string          `json:"question_id"`
	Position      int             `json:"position"`
	Type          string          `json:"type"`
	Stem          string          `json:"stem"`
	StemMedia     json.RawMessage `json:"stem_media,omitempty"`
	Options       json.RawMessage `json:"options,omitempty"`
	DurationLimit *int            `json:"duration_limit,omitempty"`
	Token         string          `json:"token"`
	Answered      bool            `json:"answered"`
}

// CreateSessionResponse 是创建会话的返回。
type CreateSessionResponse struct {
	SessionID     string            `json:"session_id"`
	ExpiresAt     time.Time         `json:"expires_at"`
	PassThreshold float64           `json:"pass_threshold"`
	RuleVersion   int               `json:"rule_version"`
	Questions     []SessionQuestion `json:"questions"`
}

// AnswerResult 是单题判分结果。
type AnswerResult struct {
	Correct       bool            `json:"correct"`
	CorrectAnswer json.RawMessage `json:"correct_answer"`
	Explain       string          `json:"explain,omitempty"`
	DurationMS    int             `json:"duration_ms"`
	Suspicious    bool            `json:"suspicious"`
	Score         float64         `json:"score"`
	Threshold     float64         `json:"threshold"`
	Answered      int             `json:"answered"`
	Total         int             `json:"total"`
	Remaining     int             `json:"remaining"`
}

// SessionSummary 是会话状态。
type SessionSummary struct {
	SessionID     string            `json:"session_id"`
	State         string            `json:"state"`
	Score         float64           `json:"score"`
	Threshold     float64           `json:"pass_threshold"`
	CorrectCount  int               `json:"correct_count"`
	AnsweredCount int               `json:"answered_count"`
	QuestionCount int               `json:"question_count"`
	StartedAt     time.Time         `json:"started_at"`
	ExpiresAt     time.Time         `json:"expires_at"`
	FinishedAt    *time.Time        `json:"finished_at,omitempty"`
	Questions     []SessionQuestion `json:"questions,omitempty"`
	Grant         *watch.Grant      `json:"grant,omitempty"`
	GrantError    string            `json:"grant_error,omitempty"`
}

// AnswerSubmission 是提交答案的入参。
type AnswerSubmission struct {
	Token  string          `json:"token"`
	Answer json.RawMessage `json:"answer"`
}

- remaining = minutes*60 - consumed.

- Revoked on time window.

1. Grant lifecycle:

   - Heartbeat every 30s while WATCHING (or while grant active even if paused? Server needs paused heartbeat to measure paused delta so paused time isn't counted; actually server computes delta from last heartbeat regardless and marks paused → counts as pausedSec, not consumed. If we don't heartbeat while paused, the delta when resuming gets charged as watched unless client sends `paused` at first heartbeat after resume... which would mark entire gap paused. Better: heartbeat every 30s always while grant active, with paused = !mediaActive. That matches "暂停不计量".)

2. Offline:

   - When network returns: report offline entries via POST /watch/logs (lease id + entries), then resync active grant. Then clear reported entries.

## 播放计费

```text
heartbeat status=active remaining=1140 paused=false

heartbeat status=active remaining=1080 paused=false
...
```

- 每 30 秒一次心跳，服务端 `consumed_seconds` 同步增长；
- 本地 `grantSeconds` 每秒递减，电视诊断页显示「剩余授权」。

## 暂停不计量

```text
18:07:28  remaining=540  paused=false   ← 暂停前
18:07:58  remaining=540  paused=true    ← 暂停 30s
18:08:28  remaining=540  paused=true    ← 暂停 60s
18:08:33  state IDLE -> WATCHING        ← 继续播放
```

暂停 60 秒，剩余时间**完全不变**。

## 断网与补报

```text
heartbeat failed: Failed to connect to /127.0.0.1:18080   ×4
服务端恢复后：
heartbeat status=active remaining=780
offline reported=3m remaining=37m clamped=false
POST /v1/watch/logs 200
```

断网期间本地继续累计，恢复联网后自动补报，无需人工操作。

## 其他

- 授权耗尽（`status=exhausted`）→ 自动进入 `QUIZ_REQUIRED` 并提示「按确认键开始答题」；
- 授权被撤销（如超出允许时段）→ `BLOCKED`；
- 设备启动时自动拉取 `GET /v1/watch/grants/active`，重启不丢授权。

## 记入计划的偏差

1. 服务端目前允许同一设备存在多条 `active` 授权，建议签发新授权时关闭旧的（服务端待办）。
2. 没有离线租约时不缓存补报，只做本地倒计时。
3. `adb reverse` 删除不会断开 OkHttp 长连接，模拟断网要停服务端进程。

```
ForegroundDetector 发现视频播放
  -> GuardEngine 拉取 /child/context
  -> 需要答题：Toast/TTS 提示「按确认键开始答题」，进入 armed 状态
  -> 用户按 OK：播放器自身暂停（不重启，无广告）
  -> AccessibilityService 监听按键（不消费），延迟 ~600ms
  -> 拉起半透明 QuizActivity（玩家 Activity 不被 stop，保持 paused）
  -> POST /quiz/sessions -> 答题 -> /answers -> /finish
  -> 通过：退出答题，提示「按确认键继续观看」
  -> 用户按 OK：播放器恢复，进度保留
  -> 超时未按键/不支持按键：回退到全屏 Activity 接管（可能重播广告）
```

- 题目与选项大字、焦点清晰；低龄支持图片/语音；
- 单题限时与服务端一致；
- 断网时不允许答题解锁，只展示离线说明。

## 8. 授权、心跳与离线

- 启动/唤醒：`GET /watch/grants/active`；
- 心跳：30s，携带 `foreground_app`、`paused`、`position_seconds`；
- 授权到期/吊销：立即拉起阻挡界面；
- 离线：预取 `/offline/lease`，本地验签 Ed25519；播放时长本地累计，恢复后 `/watch/logs` 对账；
- 离线期间不产生新的答题解锁；
- 所有时间以服务端返回的 `server_time` 校正。

## 9. 权限与引导

| 权限 | 必需 | 用途 | 失败处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 无障碍 | 是 | 前台识别、看门狗 | 引导开启，未开启进入受限模式 |
| 使用情况访问 | 是 | 计时校正 | 引导开启 |
| 悬浮窗 | 否 | 部分机型遮罩 | 创维不需要 |
| 通知使用权 | 否 | MediaSession | 无则走 Activity 接管 |
| 前台服务/自启 | 是 | 守护常驻 | 引导电池优化白名单 |
| 安装未知应用 | 否 | 仅内测 | 商店安装 |

首次启动流程：激活码 → 家长绑定 → 权限逐项引导 → 自检 → 进入守护。

## 10. 防绕过
Read section 10 防绕过 and 13 未决问题.

content.text:
## 10. 防绕过

| 场景 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 按 HOME | 看门狗 1s 内重新拉起阻挡 |
| 切换其他 App | 拦截模式重新拉起；允许应用放行 |
| 重启电视 | BootReceiver 启动守护，恢复状态 |
| 关闭无障碍 | 检测并上报 `permission_revoked`，家长端告警 |
| 卸载 | Device Owner 模式禁止；标准模式检测 |
| 改系统时间 | 服务端时间校正，偏差过大限制 |
| 断网 | 离线租约限时，恢复对账 |
| HDMI/投屏 | 明确不支持，协议声明 |

## 11. 非功能

- 启动 ≤3s；守护内存 ≤150MB；心跳耗电可接受；
- 崩溃自动重启守护；关键路径本地日志；
- 隐私：只采集包名/时长/授权状态，不采集画面与内容；
- 合规：家长同意、儿童数据最小化、可注销。

## 12. 测试矩阵

| 维度 | 覆盖 |
| --- | --- |
| 机型 | 创维 3T223_P31（已测）、小米/当贝/TCL/索尼（待测） |
| 系统 | Android 9、10、11、12+ |
| 场景 | 正片/广告/暂停/切集/退出/重启/断网/权限关闭/HOME 逃逸 |
| App | 创维影视、爱奇艺、腾讯、云视听（商店安装） |
| 指标 | 接管延迟、恢复成功率、进度保留、广告重播、看门狗延迟 |

验收口径（暂定）：

- 接管到画面消失 ≤1s；
- 退出后进度保留率 100%（创维实测通过）；
- 看门狗重新拉起 ≤2s；
- 广告重播作为已知机型限制记录，不计失败。

## 13. 风险与未决问题

| 风险 | 影响 | 对策 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Android 10+ 后台 Activity 启动受限 | 接管失败 | 逐机型验证；必要时 Device Owner/悬浮窗 |
| 恢复时重播广告 | 体验 | 接受；厂商白名单/预装消除 |
| 第三方 App 侧载被拦截 | 只能商店安装 | 引导商店安装；厂商合作 |
| 播放器不自动续播 | 需手动继续 | 文案提示 + 恢复按钮 |
| 无障碍被关闭 | 管控失效 | 检测+告警+引导 |
| 按键过滤在部分机型不可用 | 无法实现无广告暂停 | 逐机型验证；回退全屏接管 |
| 用户不按确认键/超时 | 答题无法开始 | 提示 + 超时回退（接受广告） |
| 语音答题 ASR 成本 | 低龄体验 | 二期先点选，语音后续 |

未决：

- 是否申请 Device Owner 作为增强模式？
- 家长端解锁（临时密码/远程放行）如何设计？
- 广告是否可在恢复时通过播放器历史跳过？
- 多用户/儿童模式与系统账号的关系？

## 14. 变更记录

| 日期 | 变更 | 原因 |
| --- | --- | --- |

I'll add design amendments:
- §7: blocker flow + timeout fallback (already stated).
- §10: watchdog allowlist behavior.
- §13: resolve parent unlock as "远程放行：家长端/后台签发新授权，电视轮询 active grant 自动解锁；PIN 输入待家长端" — update unresolved item.

Add a new subsection 7.1 "阻挡与家长解锁（T8）" with concrete mechanism:
- BLOCKED → BlockerActivity; back disabled; watchdog relaunch within 2s for media apps.
- 重新答题 → 直接拉起 QuizActivity（全屏回退，视频已暂停）。
- 家长解锁 → 显示等待页，每 5s GET active grant；出现新授权即 adopted 并退出。
- QUIZ_REQUIRED 90s 未按键且媒体前台 → 回退全屏 QuizActivity。
- 允许应用：系统/桌面/本应用不拦截。

Then implement.

Also update §14 change log with 2026-11-03 entry. Let me see change log lines.
